people.gloss: Listens to the pines (Lý Bạch: như thính vạn hác tùng)
people.role: Head of Vạn Hác Viện, the zither academy of the ravines; the one living player who has played its canon to the end
people.appearance: A long, thin old man with nails grown hard as plectra and a habit of tapping out the rhythm of whoever is speaking to him.
people.backstory: Hà Thính Tùng was born in Tùng Phong Thôn in 830, in the hamlet where the academy's students have practised since 622 and the villagers learned to sleep through anything (A056). He did not sleep. He listened, and at nine he walked up the ravine and played the first movement back on a borrowed zither. He has been head since 980. He keeps the monk's Pine-Wind Zither (C130) and plays it once a year. In 1060 he chose a zither from the dead makers' stock for a girl of the pines, Vi Thanh Âm (vi_thanh_am), and taught her the academy's tablature so she could keep her own scores. In 1080 his student Khương Lạc Huyền (khuong_lac_huyen) played for Thiên Xu's envoy Bách Vong Ngôn (bach_vong_ngon), who did not deliver his message (A062), and has learned the zither from Hà by letter ever since. He has outlived every player who could follow him to the twelfth movement. He has a century left, perhaps less, and the movement takes a whole night.
people.wants: To hear one student play the canon's twelfth movement to the end before he dies.
people.secret: In 1162 Vi Thanh Âm played him a piece in the academy's tablature that was not music. He recognised the rhythm of the pines' unwritten canon and understood what she was writing. He has told no one, and he has not decided whether that was kindness or a crime against his lord.

tree.intent: Wind for art speed and the echo, Wood second for the lulling verses: he fights by making a foe listen until it has nothing left.
tree.targets_note: Gong route from Wind, then Open Sky Breath and Riding the Wind for art speed, then Clinging Tendril for the lulling verses.

build.note: The zither master of ten thousand ravines: songs that march and lull, and a silence that ends them.

people.role: Master of the instrument rooms on the ravine rim; the last zither-maker of Cầm Tượng Trấn
people.appearance: A heavy man with sawdust in his eyebrows and two fingers of his left hand crushed flat.
people.backstory: A zither-maker's son of Cầm Tượng Trấn whom Hà Thính Tùng (ha_thinh_tung) taught the canon as a boy. He went home to the workshop and was there in 1012 when the ravine wall buried half the town (V041). His father Cù Cổ Đồng (cu_co_dong) died under it. He dug the Stringless Zither out of the rubble and led the makers up to the academy's rim. He keeps his father's ledger of every zither the town made, with the weight of each.

ties.note: his father, the master maker, dead 1012

people.role: The head's true disciple and heir; the academy's best player of the Monk's Rest
people.appearance: A small woman who has not raised her voice in a hundred years and whose rests make other players stop.
people.backstory: Born on the ravine rim to two of the makers who came up after 1012 (V041), she has never been further from the academy than Tùng Phong Thôn. Hà Thính Tùng (ha_thinh_tung) chose her as heir for her silences: she can hold the Monk's Rest until a room forgets to breathe. She has played the canon to the ninth movement. She is afraid of the twelfth.

ties.note: the famous one, passed over for her
inner student of the heir; tunes her zither before dawn
inner student of the third movement; wants to be the first after the heir

tree.intent: Metal notes and long silences; she wins by stopping.
tree.targets_note: Gong route, then Chime Bells and Lake Trigram: soul resistance and long silences.

people.role: Elder of the outer gate; the student whose playing made Thiên Xu's envoy forget his message in 1080
people.appearance: A handsome old student in a scarlet sash, who still tells the envoy story at every banquet.
people.backstory: A Tùng Phong Thôn boy who played under the pines in 1080 so well that Thiên Xu's envoy forgot his message (A062). The continent told the story, and he has lived on it for 120 years. He does not know the envoy, Bách Vong Ngôn (bach_vong_ngon), only pretended to forget. He expected to be heir. Hà Thính Tùng (ha_thinh_tung) chose the quiet Quan Tịch Âm (quan_tich_am) instead, and he teaches the outer gate.

people.backstory: Born on the ravine rim, granddaughter of a maker who survived 1012 (V041); she twists the strings from silk and the thin malachite wire of Thạch Lục Khoáng, and is the only one Cù Đồng Mộc (cu_dong_moc) lets weigh a zither.

people.cause: withered with his tree when his own art turned on him, at 121 (V039)
people.role: Abbot of Khô Mộc Tự; the monk whose zither the academy was founded round (620)
people.backstory: The abbot of Khô Mộc Tự, the Temple of the Withered Tree. In 620 he came down into the ravines of Thâm Tùng Hải and played under the pines until they sounded like ten thousand ravines. He left his zither with the woodcutters and charcoal-burners who had listened, and they founded the academy round it (C130). He went back to his temple. In 641 his own art turned on him and he withered with his tree (V039). The academy does not say what he was trying to do (N-van_hac-01).

ties.note: the academy's heads after him (lineage)

people.cause: buried when the ravine wall fell on Cầm Tượng Trấn, at 112 (V041)
people.role: Master zither-maker of Cầm Tượng Trấn and the academy's guest craftsman; made Vi Thanh Âm's zither
people.backstory: Made the academy's zithers for eighty years, the last of them for the pines in 1011 (Vi Thanh Âm's), and died under the ravine wall the next spring (V041).

ties.note: his son, who dug out the stringless zither
